name: Jace's house
description: Jace's Ravnican home with a vast library, a gymnasium and a roof garden, where the Gatewatch lives.

description_citations.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana wakes a hungover Chandra at noon in Jace's house.
timeline.quote: Morning, Liliana

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana guesses Chandra spent the night at the Izzet air races.
timeline.quote: You went to see the Izzet air races.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana notes Nissa has barely left the roof garden since the first morning.
timeline.quote: She's been staying in the roof garden ever since.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana explains she keeps her own lodgings because she dislikes relying on others, hiding that she will not sleep under a roof Jace paid for.
timeline.quote: I mislike relying on the mercy of others

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: In the courtyard Nissa conjures a bush-beast that drives Gideon into the ground, testing his indestructibility.
timeline.quote: Its front limbs interlaced into a single fist, which it drove down on Gideon like an avalanche.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Nissa if his habit of clapping shoulders makes her uncomfortable and promises to stop.
timeline.quote: That thing I do, where I clap people on the shoulder? Does that make you uncomfortable?

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana bristles that Nissa gets apologies while she once had to learn to break fingers.
timeline.quote: Two hundred years ago, she'd had to learn to break fingers.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana reflects that Jace swore Lavinia to secrecy about planeswalking, and Lavinia guards him to keep him from leaving.
timeline.quote: to swear her to secrecy

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana makes Jace drop his tidy glamour, revealing him tired and unkempt.
timeline.quote: You can drop the glamour, dear. No one cares.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains he has put word out through Tamiyo that the Gatewatch is ready to help.
timeline.quote: I've put word out through Tamiyo that the Gatewatch is ready to help.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace introduces Dovin Baan, a Minister of Inspections from Kaladesh, as the first to seek out the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Our guest is Dovin Baan.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan presents himself as a representative of the Consulate of Kaladesh and describes its unified system.
timeline.quote: I have the honor of coming before you as an officially and duly designated representative of the Consulate of Kaladesh.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan explains that the Inventors' Fair preparations have been disrupted by vandals.
timeline.quote: preparations have been repeatedly disrupted by vandals and malcontents

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes Baan wants the Gatewatch to provide security and hunt the renegades.
timeline.quote: So, to be clear, you want the Gatewatch to provide...security?

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra storms out of the meeting furious at Baan's description of the renegades.
timeline.quote: Chandra's chair tilted over backward as she bolted to her feet.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan asks who makes decisions for the group, and Jace and Gideon each fumble to name a leader.
timeline.quote: Gideon is the battlefield commander...

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Baan the Gatewatch handles outside threats, not internal ones, so its hands are tied.
timeline.quote: our hands are tied.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan accepts Liliana's reasoning and prepares to leave.
timeline.quote: I did not fully comprehend the strictures you operate under.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon invites Baan to stay for dinner and a tour of the headquarters.
timeline.quote: Minister, you should at least stay for dinner.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace reveals influential Azorius Senate members were petrified while he was away.
timeline.quote: a few influential members in the Azorius Senate were...eliminated.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains a planeswalking gorgon assassin with a grudge against the Azorius swore she would return.
timeline.quote: About a year ago, there was a gorgon assassin operating on Ravnica.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace asks Gideon to investigate the petrifications and work with the Azorius.
timeline.quote: I'd like you to investigate this.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls that she and Jace once worked for Tezzeret's Consortium (backstory).
timeline.quote: when she and Jace had worked for Tezzeret's criminal Consortium

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana feels the Chain Veil in its hidden pocket and the whispering spirits inside it.
timeline.quote: She laid a hand over the hidden pocket where she kept the Chain Veil.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Liliana he hates it when she takes over, and she answers that she remembers when he enjoyed that.
timeline.quote: I remember when you enjoyed that.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra rages that the Consulate killed Kaladesh's best inventors as she punches Gideon's punching bag.
timeline.quote: They killed the best damn inventors on Kaladesh.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon's punching bag bursts into flames and Chandra puts it out with a bucket, leaving a sand pile.
timeline.quote: The canvas of Gids's punchybag bursts into flames.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra wonders whether she belongs and thinks of returning to Regatha.
timeline.quote: I should go back to Regatha.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra remembers floating in green when she touched Nissa's mind and is drawn to seek her out.
timeline.quote: She was floating in green and I could breathe there.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds Nissa sitting on moss in her flower-filled room.
timeline.quote: She's sitting cross-legged on a patch of moss.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra clumsily tells Nissa that on Zendikar she felt Nissa's calm mind behind the world's anger.
timeline.quote: But behind Zendikar, behind the anger and the power, I felt you

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa offers to teach Chandra to meditate.
timeline.quote: I can teach you to meditate, if you wish.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Mortified, Chandra flees Nissa's room.
timeline.quote: I turn and run, trailing sparks, trees and flowers smearing around me, banging through the door.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra rushes past Baan and Gideon, apologizing for blowing up the punching bag.
timeline.quote: SorryIblewupyourthingy

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa, daydreaming of waking as a seed in the dark, is jolted back by Gideon at dinner.
timeline.quote: I'm not a seed.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Baan about what Nissa and Chandra did on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: I was telling Minister Baan what you did on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan contrasts aether with leylines, and Nissa explains that on her world they ask rather than take.
timeline.quote: We don't take.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace returns from his paperwork and Lavinia hands him tea, anticipating his needs.
timeline.quote: It's my job to anticipate you, Guildpact,

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan voices his deterministic view that a criminal will forever remain a criminal.
timeline.quote: A criminal will forever remain a criminal.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Lavinia reports that Liliana and Chandra spent the afternoon in the market district and then planeswalked together.
timeline.quote: They spent the afternoon wandering the market district

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan recognizes Chandra's surname and reveals Pia and Kiran Nalaar were renegade luminaries.
timeline.quote: Pia and Kiran Nalaar were early luminaries of the renegade movement.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan explains that Chandra's parents, hunted after she manifested pyromancy, were reported dead when Bunarat was set ablaze.
timeline.quote: the girl escaped custody when she manifested dangerous pyromantic abilities

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon defends Chandra, saying her parents' sins have nothing to do with her.
timeline.quote: But her heart's the size of the moon.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa says Chandra's past was hers to share, since everyone has scars others should not touch.
timeline.quote: We all have scars we don't want others to touch.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Lavinia stops Jace from leaving to find Chandra, saying Gideon and Nissa can search for Monk Nalaar.
timeline.quote: They can find Monk Nalaar.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa volunteers to go to Kaladesh with Baan and stand with Chandra.
timeline.quote: I'll stand with her.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

pages_say.description: Jace's Ravnican home with a vast library, a gymnasium and a roof garden, where the Gatewatch lives.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.
